nodes.name: context.tsx
nodes.summary: Sidebar plugin showing session context usage — total token count from the last assistant response, context-window percentage, and accumulated cost across the session.

nodes.name: files.tsx
nodes.summary: Sidebar plugin listing files modified in the session with per-file diff counters, collapsible when there are more than two entries.

nodes.name: footer.tsx
nodes.summary: Sidebar footer plugin showing the project path with git branch, plus a dismissible getting-started hint shown only when no paid providers are configured.

nodes.name: lsp.tsx
nodes.summary: Sidebar plugin listing LSP server statuses, with empty-state hints when LSPs are disabled or will activate once files are read.

nodes.name: mcp.tsx
nodes.summary: Sidebar plugin summarizing MCP server health — connected/failed counts computed in a single pass, per-server status rows with colored dots, and expand/collapse behavior.

nodes.name: todo.tsx
nodes.summary: Sidebar plugin rendering the session's todo list with normalized statuses and priorities, hidden when everything is completed or the list is empty.

nodes.name: plugins.tsx
nodes.summary: Plugin manager dialog — lists installed plugins with source metadata and enabled/active state, and supports browsing plus installing new plugins.

nodes.name: session-v2.tsx
nodes.summary: The v2 session view (experimental) — renders the SessionMessage stream end to end: user/shell/compaction/agent-switch/model-switch messages, assistant text, reasoning, and a family of dedicated per-tool renderers (Bash, Read, Edit, ApplyPatch, TodoWrite, Question, Task, and more).
nodes.languageNotes: AssistantTool dispatches each tool part to a per-tool SolidJS component selected by tool name with a GenericTool fallback; small helpers (input, filetype, normalizePath, toolOutput) shape tool input/output for display.

nodes.name: which-key.tsx
nodes.summary: Emacs-style which-key panel — surfaces available keybindings and pending key sequences in a layout-persisted overlay, with grouping, scrolling, and group navigation commands.

nodes.name: keymap.tsx
nodes.summary: Keymap infrastructure for the TUI — wraps @opentui/keymap with provider re-exports, key alias expansion (enter→return, esc→escape), leader-key support, binding formatting helpers, and registration of opencode-specific bindings from resolved config.

nodes.name: layer.ts
nodes.summary: Six-line Effect layer composition merging observability, TUI config, and the NPM layers into CliLayer for the CLI TUI runtime.

nodes.name: api.tsx
nodes.summary: Factory building the TuiPluginApi object handed to every TUI plugin — wires route registration and navigation, slot composition, dialogs (alert/confirm/prompt/select), toast, KV, keymap formatting, renderer access, and a memoized state API over the sync store.

nodes.name: View
nodes.summary: Computes session token totals, context-window percentage against the active model's limit, and cumulative cost, rendering them as sidebar rows.

nodes.name: tui
nodes.summary: Plugin entry registering the context usage view in the sidebar content slot.

nodes.name: View
nodes.summary: Renders modified files with add/remove diff counters in a collapsible sidebar section.

nodes.name: tui
nodes.summary: Plugin entry registering the modified-files view in the sidebar content slot.

nodes.name: View
nodes.summary: Renders the sidebar footer — project directory with git branch, plus a dismissible getting-started banner shown only when no paid providers are configured.

nodes.name: tui
nodes.summary: Plugin entry registering the footer view in the sidebar footer slot.

nodes.name: View
nodes.summary: Renders LSP server status rows with state indicators and empty-state guidance for disabled or idle servers.

nodes.name: tui
nodes.summary: Plugin entry registering the LSP status view in the sidebar content slot.

nodes.name: View
nodes.summary: Renders the MCP health summary — single-pass connected/failed counts, colored status dots per server, and an expandable server list.

nodes.name: tui
nodes.summary: Plugin entry registering the MCP status view in the sidebar content slot.

nodes.name: View
nodes.summary: Renders the session todo list with normalized status icons and priority markers, auto-hidden when all items are completed.

nodes.name: tui
nodes.summary: Plugin entry registering the todo list view in the sidebar content slot.

nodes.name: state
nodes.summary: Renders a plugin's enabled/active state as a colored status span (disabled, active, or inactive).

nodes.name: Install
nodes.summary: Renders the plugin installation flow — registry listing, selection, and install progress presented inside a dialog.

nodes.name: row
nodes.summary: Renders one plugin row combining title, source metadata, and state indicator for the plugin list.

nodes.name: View
nodes.summary: Main plugin manager view — lists installed plugins with enable/disable handling and an entry point to install new ones from the registry.

nodes.name: tui
nodes.summary: Plugin entry registering the plugin manager view, its route, command, and keybindings.

nodes.name: View
nodes.summary: Top-level v2 session view — resolves the current session's messages from the v2 sync store and dispatches each SessionMessage to its dedicated renderer.

nodes.name: MissingData
nodes.summary: Placeholder view rendered while session data has not yet loaded.

nodes.name: UserMessage
nodes.summary: Renders a user message, resolving attached file parts into labeled blocks.

nodes.name: ShellMessage
nodes.summary: Renders a shell (background command) message with its command line and execution status.

nodes.name: CompactionMessage
nodes.summary: Renders a compaction summary message shown after context compaction.

nodes.name: AgentSwitchedMessage
nodes.summary: Renders a notice that the session switched to a different agent.

nodes.name: ModelSwitchedMessage
nodes.summary: Renders a notice that the session switched to a different model.

nodes.name: AssistantMessage
nodes.summary: Renders an assistant message — iterates its parts (text, reasoning, tool calls) with time tracking and per-part completion state.

nodes.name: AssistantText
nodes.summary: Renders assistant text parts as markdown-highlighted code blocks.

nodes.name: AssistantReasoning
nodes.summary: Renders reasoning parts with a collapsible label and dimmed styling.

nodes.name: AssistantTool
nodes.summary: Dispatches a tool part to its dedicated renderer by tool name — Bash, Read, Edit, ApplyPatch, TodoWrite, and others — falling back to GenericTool for unknown tools.

nodes.name: GenericTool
nodes.summary: Fallback renderer showing a tool's title, pending input preview, and truncated output for tools without a dedicated component.

nodes.name: InlineTool
nodes.summary: Renders tools that display as inline status lines — animates pending state with a spinner and shows completion output inline.

nodes.name: BlockTool
nodes.summary: Base block-style tool renderer with a bordered layout, title row, and output area.

nodes.name: Bash
nodes.summary: Renders bash tool calls — the command line, exit code, and duration.

nodes.name: Glob
nodes.summary: Renders glob tool results as a compact list of matched paths.

nodes.name: Read
nodes.summary: Renders file read results with syntax highlighting when the file type is known.

nodes.name: Grep
nodes.summary: Renders grep results as matched lines with line numbers.

nodes.name: Write
nodes.summary: Renders file writes with a themed diff preview of the new content.

nodes.name: Edit
nodes.summary: Renders edit tool calls as themed diffs of the old and new strings.

nodes.name: ApplyPatch
nodes.summary: Renders apply_patch tool calls, parsing the patch body into per-file diff blocks.

nodes.name: TodoWrite
nodes.summary: Renders todo updates with status icons and item counts.

nodes.name: Question
nodes.summary: Renders the question tool with its options and the selected answer.

nodes.name: Task
nodes.summary: Renders subagent task calls with a spinner while running and a result summary on completion.

nodes.name: Diagnostics
nodes.summary: Renders LSP diagnostics reports per file with severity-based coloring.

nodes.name: todoIcon
nodes.summary: Maps a todo status (pending, in-progress, completed) to its display icon.

nodes.name: tui
nodes.summary: Plugin entry registering the v2 session view, its routes, and scroll/navigation commands.

nodes.name: skin
nodes.summary: Builds which-key panel styling — colors, borders, and text attributes — from the current theme.

nodes.name: activeKeyEntry
nodes.summary: Resolves the currently pending keybinding entry description from the keymap's active key state.

nodes.name: grouped
nodes.summary: Groups keybinding entries by their key-group prefix for panel display.

nodes.name: HomeHint
nodes.summary: Renders a small home-screen hint showing the which-key toggle shortcut.

nodes.name: WhichKeyPanel
nodes.summary: The which-key overlay itself — renders grouped keybinding entries with scrolling, group navigation, layout toggling, and pending-key preview, with preferences persisted via KV.

nodes.name: tui
nodes.summary: Plugin entry registering the which-key panel as a high-priority layer along with its toggle, layout, and scroll/navigation commands.

nodes.name: formatOptions
nodes.summary: Formats the keymap options block — leader-key display and recognized key aliases — for display.

nodes.name: formatKeySequence
nodes.summary: Formats a parsed key sequence into a display string using the leader-aware config.

nodes.name: formatKeyBindings
nodes.summary: Formats a command's key bindings for display using the current TUI config.

nodes.name: registerOpencodeKeymap
nodes.summary: Registers opencode-specific key aliases and bindings onto the renderer's keymap, driven by resolved TUI config keybinds.

nodes.name: useCommandShortcut
nodes.summary: Hook registering a command with optional keybindings via useBindings.

nodes.name: useLeaderActive
nodes.summary: Hook returning whether a leader-key sequence is currently active in the keymap.

nodes.name: routeRegister
nodes.summary: Registers a list of route renderers under their route names, returning a cleanup that removes only this registration's entries.

nodes.name: routeNavigate
nodes.summary: Navigates to a named route with parameters, with fallback behavior for unknown routes.

nodes.name: routeCurrent
nodes.summary: Returns the current route name and parameters from the route store.

nodes.name: pickOption
nodes.summary: Maps a dialog item to the select-option shape used by plugin-facing dialogs.

nodes.name: stateApi
nodes.summary: Builds the plugin-facing state API over the sync store — memoized accessors for messages, parts, todos, diffs, providers, MCP/LSP status, and more.

nodes.name: createTuiApi
nodes.summary: Composes the full TuiPluginApi handed to plugins — slots, routes, dialogs, toast, KV, theme, renderer, keymap formatting, and the state API — from the TUI's internal contexts.
